topics.text: The property features modern amenities including a spring-fed swimming pool, table tennis, billiards, and KTV. Outdoor activities like hiking, stream exploration, and tea gatherings are available, enhancing the recreational experience.

Rooms are spacious, well-decorated, and maintained to high standards, with clean bedding, fresh air, and natural light. Many reviews highlight the comfort of beds, cleanliness of bathrooms, and the availability of new equipment.

Owners and staff are consistently praised for their warmth, attentiveness, and willingness to assist with travel planning, photography, and local recommendations. The hostess is particularly noted for her photogenic skills and hospitality towards families and pets.

Dining experiences include fresh, locally sourced meals such as mountain fish and bamboo shoots, with breakfast options featuring porridge and pickled vegetables. Some accommodations offer pre-ordered meals and family-style dining in scenic settings.

comments.quote: 和閨蜜小聚，選擇了德清莫干山，入住了陌野和居 7.25入住當天，老闆很熱情的接待，幫忙提行李，大廳放了好幾種水果、零食，大家隨便自取，是個懂生活的人，此處值得點贊；晚餐在老闆家吃的，因為沒有提前跟老闆預約晚餐，就有啥吃啥了，一份土雞煲（味道不錯），兩份當季菜，一份麪條，價格還算可以，晚上老闆陪打，老闆娘給我和閨蜜拍了一個多小時照片，非常耐心、熱情，最重要的是拍照技術超好，直接用來發朋友圈，總之很貼心，會被他們家的服務打動，有來德清玩的朋友，可首選他家🌹🌹🌹
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: 特意來誇這家藏在小山村裡的寶藏民宿！整間屋子被青山環繞，環境清幽雅緻，隨處都是自然美景，安靜又治癒，氛圍感獨一無二。全屋打掃得十分乾淨整潔，細節處處用心，住着特別舒服。老闆娘性格温柔大方，待人熱情和善，貼心又周到，像在家一樣自在。遠離鬧市的絕佳休憩地，體驗感滿分，強烈推薦！
comments.author: Guest User
